==Description==
'''Giga AJ''' was a narrator used for [[Cyber City]] as part of the [[Metaverse Champions Event]].

'''Giga AJ''' is the [[w:c:roblox:Catalog:AJ_Striker|AJ Striker]] from the Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:Metaverse Champions|Metaverse Champions]].

==Appearance==
'''Giga AJ''' took the appearance of the [[w:c:roblox:Catalog:AJ_Striker|AJ Striker]] from the Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:Metaverse Champions|Metaverse Champions]]. He had tan skin, brown hair and a short brown beard. He wore a blue shirt, blue camo pants, black shoes and vest. His right arm was fully mechanical while his left arm had a few tattoos on it. Around his neck, he had a blue scarf.

==Trivia==
*The '''Giga AJ''' could be seen in the lobby next to the portal for the [[Metaverse Champions Event]].
**He could be seen sitting in his Default icon pose. Interacting with him would also show a larger version of its default icon showcasing more of its body.
*The '''Giga AJ's''' name and poses are a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/gigachad GigaChad] meme.
